name: Zhongman Petroleum and Natural Gas Group Corp.,Ltd.
summary: Zhongman Petroleum and Natural Gas Group Corp.,Ltd., an oil and gas company, provides integrated oil and gas development services in China and internationally. It engages in exploration and development, drilling and completion engineering, and equipment manufacturing business. The company explores for, develops, and produces oil and gas deposits.
